group_structure: Finance House P.J.S.C. (ADX: FH) consolidates: Finance House L.L.C. (100%, financing services; goodwill sits here), Insurance House P.J.S.C. (45.61%, non-life insurance, consolidated as a subsidiary), Finance House Securities Co L.L.C. (70%, brokerage, SCA licence 604025), FH Capital P.J.S. (100%, investment and asset management; operates the investnation app), Dhabi Ltd (100%, ADGM; FSRA Prudential Category 1, FSP 200020, accepting deposits and providing credit; launched 11 Jun 2026) and FH Holdings L.L.C. (100%, holding company), all at 30 Jun 2026. Associates: Empay LLC (30%, digital payments) and Mainland Management L.L.C. (33.33%). Dhabi Ltd was listed as a separate institution in the original workbook; it is folded into this profile. Group figures below are consolidated and must not be attributed to Dhabi Ltd or Finance House L.L.C. alone.

footprint: UAE (head office Abu Dhabi; FHS has offices in Abu Dhabi and Dubai). Dhabi Ltd operates from ADGM since Jun 2026 and targets cross-border clients. Branch count not stated on the website (checked 2026-10-12).
customer_segments: UAE retail borrowers (credit cards, gold loans, home finance, Sulfah), SMEs and corporates (commercial and corporate finance, trade finance, WPS payroll), depositors (deposits are almost all corporate per the H1 2026 sector split), retail investors via investnation and FHS, insurance clients via Insurance House, and globally mobile individuals and businesses via Dhabi Ltd.
business_lines: Five reported segments: commercial and retail financing; investment (proprietary portfolio and treasury); Islamic financing and investing (small, AED 4.3m assets); brokerage (FHS); insurance (Insurance House). Retail products: Rabeh, Sanad, Forsa, Platinum, investnation and CartNet credit cards, Gold Loan, Sulfah, Home Finance, Flexi/Fixed/MYFD deposits. Securities services: share registrar, dividend distribution, AGM management and IPO administration. FH Capital: ECM/DCM advisory and client portfolio management, plus the investnation app. Dhabi Ltd: ADGM deposit and credit banking from Jun 2026.

capabilities.wealth_summary: Finance House is an Abu Dhabi finance company, not a bank, with consumer and commercial lending, an insurance subsidiary and a small investment arm. Retail investing runs through FH Capital P.J.S. (SCA portfolio-management licence), which operates the investnation app: three discretionary plans (Saver, Flex, Growth) invested mainly in money-market placements and bank deposits, with some bonds, commercial paper and sukuk; projected returns up to 5–7% a year, UAE PASS onboarding, SIPs, a junior account and a bullion account (gold/silver from AED 250). In Jul 2025 it launched the investnation credit card, giving a credit limit of up to 90% of an earmarked investment of at least AED 3,000. Finance House Securities (70%) offers ADX/DFM brokerage with online and mobile trading. No AUM, user numbers, private-banking or structured-product offer is disclosed. Dhabi Ltd, launched in ADGM on 11 Jun 2026, offers deposits and accounts for cross-border clients; no wealth products were announced.

private_banking.detail: No private-banking or HNW proposition found on financehouse.ae, fhcapital.ae or investnation.com. Dhabi Ltd markets a 'premium' cross-border banking experience but announced only accounts and deposits.

asset_management.detail: FH Capital P.J.S. (100%; SCA licences 603043 / 20200000145; share capital AED 55m): client portfolio management plus ECM/DCM/advisory investment banking. No named funds and no AUM disclosed. The parent also runs a proprietary portfolio (listed equities, pre-IPO, private equity, fixed income, funds).

brokerage.detail: Finance House Securities Co L.L.C. (70%; SCA licence 604025): brokerage on UAE markets (website shows ADX and DFM data), online trading portal and FHS Mobile Trading app (iOS/Android). Trading platform vendor not named; no international markets or margin trading mentioned. Brokerage segment assets AED 401.9m at 30 Jun 2026.

digital_investing.detail: investnation app (FH Capital P.J.S., SCA-regulated): discretionary Saver/Flex/Growth plans, bullion account, SIPs, junior investment account, UAE PASS onboarding, a 'Vault Card' issued by Finance House L.L.C., and the investnation Mastercard credit card (launched 16 Jul 2025). Launch date of the app not found. FHS Mobile Trading app for UAE equities.

advisory.detail: FH Capital holds SCA Fifth Category permissions (financial consultation, issuance manager, listing advisor) and offers corporate advisory. No retail investment-advice service described.

discretionary.detail: investnation plans are described as Discretionary Portfolio Management Account plans run by FH Capital (Saver: money-market placements; Flex: adds bonds and commercial paper; Growth: adds bonds, commercial paper and sukuk).

model_portfolios_robo.detail: Three pre-set investnation plans chosen by goal/return appetite; money-market and fixed-income based, not equity model portfolios.

funds_platform.detail: No third-party mutual fund shelf found on investnation, FH Capital or FHS websites.

private_markets.detail: The parent invests in pre-IPO and private equity for its own book (investments page); no client private-markets product found.

islamic_wealth.detail: investnation Growth plan includes some sukuk; the group's Islamic financing segment is small (AED 4.3m assets at 30 Jun 2026). No Shariah-compliant investment plan found.

initiatives.what: Launched investnation credit card: credit limit up to 90% of an earmarked investnation investment (minimum AED 3,000) while funds keep earning up to 7% a year

Dhabi Ltd (100% subsidiary, FSRA FSP 200020, Prudential Category 1) launched in ADGM as a digital-first cross-border bank offering current, savings and fixed-deposit accounts to individuals and businesses

FY2025 Board report: focus on capital ratios, liquidity, asset quality, cloud technology and 'digitally enabled Products & Services'; no dividend, to preserve cash for 'upcoming strategic initiatives'

opportunities: investnation offers only money-market, fixed-income/sukuk and bullion plans; no equity model portfolios, global ETFs, funds shelf, structured products or private markets (S15).
Dhabi Ltd (launched Jun 2026) targets globally mobile clients with deposit and account products only; no investment proposition announced (S7, S8, S10).
Board says cash is being preserved for 'upcoming strategic initiatives' and stresses digitally enabled products (FY2025 Board report, S6).
Same CEO (T.K. Raman) runs the parent and is Vice Chairman/MD of FH Capital, so a decision-maker spans lending, the investing app and the asset manager (S2, S14).
barriers: Small group: total assets AED 3.6bn and FY2025 attributable profit AED 12.2m; FY2025 audit opinion and H1 2026 review conclusion are qualified over the Empay LLC associate (S4, S5).
Investing proposition is yield-focused (projected 5–7%), funded largely by deposits and cards; equity/brokerage is limited to ADX/DFM via FHS (S15, S18).
No disclosed AUM, user numbers or named technology vendors for investnation or FHS (S12, S15, S18).
